npc/stargazer.doing: standing by the bell at the middle of the roof

happening.text: The party comes up onto the roof under a new moon just risen.
The Stargazer rings the sky through its sentences, and the party reads each one overhead.

objectives.hint: The Stargazer, by the bell in the middle of the roof.
objectives.title: Ask the Stargazer for a sky

happening.text: The bell is quiet, and the sky stays where the last sentence put it.
